newsitem.title: USA: Trader estimates for weekly USDA export net sales.
newsitem.headline: Trader estimates for weekly USDA export net sales.

text.p: Pit sources at the Chicago Board of Trade said they expected Friday's USDA weekly export sales report to show 500,000 to 700,000 tonnes of net U.S. soybean sales in the week ended November 14.
Soyoil sales were expected to total between 50,000 and 65,000 tonnes, while soymeal sales were pegged at 150,000 to 200,000 tonnes, traders said.
Corn net sales were seen at 700,000 to 850,000 tonnes while wheat sales were expected to total 250,000 to 350,000 tonnes, they said.
Last week, USDA reported soybean sales in the week ended October 7 at 1.12 million tonnes. There were sales of 221,500 tonnes of soymeal and 48,700 tonnes of soyoil.
Corn sales were at 797,300 tonnes while wheat was at 474,900 tonnes, USDA reported.
